coverage.description: With a frame-aligned predicate anchor, inspect direct children unused by any anchored role. For each unsaid slot in order, Agent matches passive OblAgent or nonpassive-subject Nsubj; Patient matches NsubjPass or non-time Obj; Recipient matches Iobj. First matching child emits a hit. Other slots abstain. Missing anchors/predicates suppress only this check.

state: Predicate/role token indices are zero-based, hits are one-based frame rows. Token use excludes the dependent regardless of which role consumed it. Frame order and anchor order must agree. Valid Tree cached children and anchor indices are premises; malformed public state can panic and is not silently repaired.
